import numpy as np, pandas as pd

# Assumption: standard Mon-Fri business days (Aurelian public holidays not specified in the excerpt)
quarters = pd.period_range("2025Q1", "2027Q1", freq="Q")
rows = []
for q in quarters:
    q_end = q.end_time.normalize()                 # last day of calendar quarter
    due = np.busday_offset(q_end.date(), 15, roll="forward")  # 15 business days after
    rows.append({
        "calendar_quarter": str(q),
        "quarter_end": q_end.date(),
        "QTR_due_by": pd.Timestamp(due).date(),
    })
pd.DataFrame(rows)
